long_biography.plain_text:
Miriam Adelson is an Israeli-American physician whose work centres on addiction medicine. After leading internal and emergency medicine at Rokach Hospital in Tel Aviv, she joined Rockefeller University as a guest investigator and associate physician, studying addiction biology with Mary Jeanne Kreek. She later established treatment and research clinics in Tel Aviv and Las Vegas, combining methadone pharmacotherapy with psychosocial care.

The Adelson Medical Research Foundation turned that clinical interest into a broader philanthropic programme. Created with Sheldon Adelson, it supported collaborations in neurology, immunology and oncology. Tel Aviv University also established an Adelson centre for the biology of addictive diseases. Her published research has examined outcomes in long-running methadone-maintenance programmes.

uncertainties.detail: Forbes presents Adelson as the widow of the Las Vegas Sands founder and gives her a low self-made score, while filings show that a large direct and trust-based holding was already in her name during the marriage. Marriage / family transfer is selected because it best captures the documented pre-2021 structure; Inherited remains a reasonable shorthand for the later estate transition.

The current headline beneficial-ownership figure includes shares held through multiple family trusts and combines sole and shared powers. The dossier therefore describes a controlling beneficial interest and family holding without treating every reported share as direct personal ownership.

Reichman University securely establishes Tel Aviv, October and 1945, but the exact day of 10 October appears mainly in lower-tier reference sources. The blank birth-day field is left unchanged pending stronger primary or major-publication evidence.

Focused searches found namesakes on LinkedIn and no officially cross-linked personal Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, X, YouTube, TikTok or personal website. None is proposed; only the exact Forbes profile and the official clinic website meet the verification threshold.

Adelson is a controlling family shareholder and trustee, but the latest securities filing names physician as her principal occupation and does not establish day-to-day management of Las Vegas Sands. The dossier therefore avoids attributing Sheldon Adelson's founder or operating history to her.
Queen Miri and its dimensions were used only to disambiguate the frozen cohort record. Neither biography nor any wealth classification mentions or depends on a vessel.
